craft_notes: Sthāyin: pure path muster. Rows: lords then kinds. Read aloud: muster roll.

lines: Here the truth-lords — Śiva, Might, the Ever-blest, Sovereign, the Boundless —
like great-father Brahmā withdrawn from all;
of these broad-run forms, five special kinds traverse the pasture:
the blessed-wise, the mighty, the great spell-lords, the spell-lords, the spells — pure path.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atra ca tattveśvarāḥ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvarānantāḥ brahmeva nivṛttau eṣāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ viśeṣā anugativiṣayāḥ pañca tadyathā śāmbhavāḥ śāktāḥ mantramaheśvarāḥ mantreśvarāḥ mantrā iti śuddhādhvā
